observations: Photo 0: Wall-mounted salon bonnet hair dryer with black hood and arm, white body, mounted on a black wall bracket. A label on the front reads 'MANGO'.
Photo 1: Close-up of the same dryer unit, showing control panel with two dial knobs and a red indicator light above the 'MANGO' brand label and a smaller blue logo beneath it.
Photo 2: Side view showing the dryer hood folded back against the wall bracket, white body hanging down, power cord visible, a black garment hanging nearby and a wooden shelf in the corner.
Photo 3: Another angle of the mounted dryer against a white wall, showing the full arm and hood mechanism, with a makeup brush holder and round mirror visible on a table below.
not_shown: Whether the heating element and motor function correctly
